shared_elements: free-standing carved stone block with rounded top
arms held low against the sides of the body
head or facial zone distinguished from torso
sculpture-in-the-round with shallow carved detail on a monolithic mass
justification: Both are monolithic stone anthropomorphic blocks with a rounded head atop a tapering body and short arms bent inward against the torso, which is a genuinely specific compositional echo. The manner of execution differs sharply: A carries a dense programme of fine incised/low-relief motifs (bands, a prominent disc, headdress elements) over its whole front, while B is reduced to a few deep gouges for eyes and nose on an otherwise blank, weathered mass, and the two differ greatly in scale and finish.
